[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Elon Musk megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: X Freeze (@XFreeze); megjelent: 2026-11-16T04:35:06+00:00; link: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2122186676164587648; média: 1 kép]
Years ago, Elon Musk predicted:

“Solar electricity will become by far the biggest source of power for civilization”

Today, we're watching that vision become reality

In 2015, solar generated just 256 TWh of electricity globally

A decade later, annual solar generation has surpassed 2,700 TWh

That's more than a 10X increase in just ten years

Solar also accounted for 83% of the growth in global electricity demand during the first half of 2025

And renewables have now overtaken coal in global electricity generation

What Elon Musk envisioned years ago is unfolding right in front of us

The Sun is a gigantic fusion reactor in space, delivering more energy to Earth in a single hour than humanity consumes in an entire year

We're still capturing only a tiny fraction of it

Solar generation is accelerating, battery storage is expanding, and the world is moving toward a future of abundant, sustainable energy

And this transformation is only getting started
